jobs.description:
**Bouw mee aan een van de nieuwste AI-initiatieven van Technische Unie**

Technische Unie bouwt aan de dienstverlening van de toekomst voor klanten én medewerkers. Met behulp van data, digital en AI willen we slimmer werken, klanten relevanter bedienen en nieuwe commerciële kansen benutten. Daarom zoeken we een AI Engineer die onderdeel wordt van een nieuw team en vanaf de start meebouwt aan slimme oplossingen met zichtbare impact op onze organisatie.

**Dit ga je doen**
------------------

Je werkt op het snijvlak van business en technologie. Samen met collega's uit sales, marketing, data en IT vertaal je commerciële kansen en klantbehoeften naar slimme AI-oplossingen die daadwerkelijk gebruikt worden.

Je gaat onder andere:

* AI-agents en toepassingen ontwikkelen die klantactivatie, verkoop en service ondersteunen;
* AI inzetten om grote groepen klanten relevanter en persoonlijker te bedienen en activeren, zonder dat daarvoor evenredig meer handmatig werk nodig is;
* klant-, product-, interactie- en commerciële data verbinden om next-best-actions en commerciële kansen slimmer te ondersteunen;
* experimenten en prototypes snel vertalen naar oplossingen die daadwerkelijk in de praktijk gebruikt kunnen worden;
* gebruik en resultaat meten en succesvolle toepassingen continu verbeteren en opschalen;
* samenwerken met Data & IT en andere specialisten om toepassingen betrouwbaar, veilig en beheersbaar te realiseren.

**Jouw team en impact**

Je stapt in een nieuw AI-team dat volop in ontwikkeling is. Samen met collega's uit de business, data en IT bouw je aan AI-oplossingen die direct waarde toevoegen voor collega's én klanten.

Je krijgt veel ruimte om kansen zelf te ontdekken, processen slimmer te maken en ideeën om te zetten in toepassingen die daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt. Zo draag je zichtbaar bij aan de verdere groei van AI binnen Technische Unie.

**Wij bieden**
--------------

Jouw ontwikkeling, gezondheid en veiligheid staan centraal. Als Top Employer bieden we veel goede arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals:

* Geniet van 40 verlofdagen (vakantie- én ATV-dagen op fulltime basis) én de optie om dagen te kopen of verkopen
* Variabele beloning en solide pensioenregeling
* Blijf vitaal met een vitaliteitsbudget, thuiswerkregeling, sportschoolkorting en gezondheidschecks
* Altijd blijven groeien met ons brede trainings- en opleidingsaanbod

**Heb jij het in je?**
----------------------

Lef, durf en aanpassingsvermogen! Dat is de mentaliteit waarmee onze collega’s het verschil maken. Of je nu net begint of al wat ervaring meebrengt, bij Technische Unie krijg je de ruimte om te ontwikkelen op jouw manier.

Iedereen brengt iets unieks mee. Juist die mix van verschillen maakt ons sterker als team. We geloven in een werksfeer waarin je jezelf kunt zijn, kunt groeien en elke dag iets nieuws kunt ontdekken.

Met meer dan 2.000 collega’s bouwen we dagelijks aan een slimmer, duurzamer Nederland. We helpen onze klanten vooruit met een breed aanbod technische producten, diensten en een krachtige online omgeving die behoort tot de grootste B2B-platforms van Nederland. Maar het echte verschil maken we met elkaar, met mensen die energie, ideeën en lef meebrengen. Heb jij het in je?

**Dit breng je mee**
--------------------

Je krijgt energie van het bouwen van slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk gebruikt worden. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar wat er met AI mogelijk is, maar begint altijd bij de vraag van de gebruiker of de business.

Daarnaast:

* heb je hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau;
* heb je ervaring met softwareontwikkeling, data, AI of automatisering;
* weet je businessvraagstukken te vertalen naar praktische en werkende oplossingen;
* ben je bekend met API's, data, cloudomgevingen en AI-toepassingen;
* heb je ervaring met generatieve AI, bijvoorbeeld AI-agents, RAG, prompt engineering, tool calling en API-integraties;
* werk je graag samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines;
* ben je ondernemend, pragmatisch en niet bang om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen.

Ervaring met Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure, CRM, e-commerce of productdata is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste. Nederlands spreken is belangrijk, omdat je veel samenwerkt met collega's binnen de business

jobs.title: Full-stack developer
jobs.description:
WeTicket ist eine All-in-one-Lösung für Online-Ticketing, die Veranstaltern hilft zu wachsen und ihre Kosten deutlich zu senken.

Das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis von Ticketsystemen ist aus dem Gleichgewicht geraten. Es ist keine Ausnahme, dass Veranstalter Gebühren von bis zu **10%** zahlen, die genau das Budget auffressen, mit dem sie ihren Gästen das beste Erlebnis bieten wollen.

Wir suchen **Full-Stack-Engineers**, die als Teil des Gründungsteams die Zukunft des Ticketings mitgestalten: ein gutes Kundenerlebnis zu einem fairen Preis.

#### **Das WeTicket-Angebot**

* Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt.
* Ein großzügiges Beteiligungspaket.
* Vollzeit, teils in unserem Büro im Zentrum von Amsterdam, mit der Möglichkeit, einige Tage pro Woche remote zu arbeiten. **Derzeit können wir weder Visa noch einen Umzug unterstützen.**
* Ein Team, das schnell iteriert und ausliefert und in dem Fehler erlaubt sind.

#### **Wen wir suchen**

Ein guter Engineer zu sein hängt nicht allein von Erfahrung mit bestimmten Frameworks, vom Alter oder von früheren Titeln ab. Wenn Sie unsicher sind, ob Sie passen, schicken Sie uns gerne Ihre Fragen.

* Nachweisliche Erfahrung als Software Engineer in einem Produktteam.
* Erfahrung mit mindestens einem der folgenden Bereiche: **C#** (**.NET**), **PostgreSQL**, **TypeScript**, **React**. Es handelt sich um eine Full-Stack-Rolle, ein klarer Schwerpunkt im Back- oder Frontend ist aber völlig in Ordnung.
* Sehr gutes Englisch und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Konzepte klar zu vermitteln.
* Gute Energie. Lassen Sie uns herausfinden, ob unsere Werte, Ziele und unsere Mission zusammenpassen.

#### **Technik**

* Unser Backend basiert auf einem **RESTful-API**-Server mit **C#** und **.NET**. Die Daten liegen in **PostgreSQL**.
* Unsere Frontends sind mit **Next.js** und **Redux** gebaut.
* Wir haben eine **React Native**-App, mit der Veranstalter Tickets vor Ort scannen.
* Wir sind noch am Anfang. Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für Teile unserer Infrastruktur und entscheiden mit, wie der Tech-Stack von WeTicket in Zukunft aussieht.

#### **Aufgaben**

* Teil des Gründungsteams sein, mit der Möglichkeit, mit der Zeit ein eigenes Team aufzubauen.
* Kernfunktionen unseres Produkts im Front- und Backend verantworten und entwickeln.
* Mit unserem Produkt- und Customer-Success-Team neue Funktionen konzipieren und umsetzen, die Wirkung haben.
* Unsere Codebasis pflegen und für optimale Performance verbessern, Code Reviews durchführen, debuggen und testen.

#### **Bewerbung**

Schreiben Sie uns an nick@weticket.com.

Nehmen Sie alles auf, was uns hilft, Ihren Hintergrund und Ihre Erfolge zu verstehen.

Besonders freuen wir uns über Hinweise auf Projekte, auf die Sie stolz sind, mit einer kurzen Erklärung, was das Projekt macht. Links zu GitHub sind immer nützlich. Lebensläufe helfen, sagen für sich genommen aber wenig aus.

* **️ Bewerbungsprozess**

* Wir sprechen 30 Minuten per Telefon oder bei einem Kaffee und schauen, ob Werte und Energie passen. Dabei reden wir darüber, was uns an WeTicket und an Technologie begeistert.

* Ein Gespräch vor Ort, bei dem Sie das Team kennenlernen und uns mehr über Ihre Arbeitsweise erzählen.

* Wenn es passt, machen wir Ihnen ein Angebot.

jobs.title: Frontend/Fullstack Developer | Consultancy
jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren Frontend (Fullstack) Developer die energie krijgt van moderne webapplicaties bouwen én graag verder kijkt dan alleen de frontend? In deze rol combineer je sterke JavaScript- en TypeScript-kennis met backendervaring en slimme inzet van AI. Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten, denkt mee over technische oplossingen en krijgt volop ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

**FUNCTIEOMSCHRIJVING**
-----------------------

Als Frontend (Fullstack) Developer werk je aan het ontwikkelen, verbeteren en onderhouden van moderne webapplicaties. Je gebruikt technologieën zoals JavaScript, TypeScript en frameworks als React, Angular, Vue of Svelte om toegankelijke, snelle en betrouwbare oplossingen te realiseren. Daarnaast breng je ervaring mee met backendontwikkeling in bijvoorbeeld Java, C#/.NET of Python. Hierdoor kijk je verder dan de gebruikersinterface en denk je mee over de technische samenhang binnen applicaties.

Je werkt aan uiteenlopende projecten bij verschillende organisaties, waardoor je regelmatig nieuwe technologieën, teams en werkwijzen leert kennen. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om jouw technische visie in te brengen, de kwaliteit van code te verbeteren en samen met andere specialisten innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

* Ontwikkelen, testen en onderhouden van moderne frontendcomponenten en webapplicaties.
* Vertalen van gebruikerswensen en ontwerpen naar toegankelijke, schaalbare en gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces.
* Inzetten van **agentic engineering** om ontwikkelprocessen te versnellen, bijvoorbeeld bij het opzetten, refactoren en reviewen van code.
* Kritisch beoordelen van AI-gegenereerde code en verantwoord omgaan met AI, kwaliteit en relevante wetgeving.
* Meedenken over architectuur, teststrategieën, CI/CD en generieke technische oplossingen.
* Samenwerken met andere developers en specialisten om de kwaliteit, performance en onderhoudbaarheid van applicaties continu te verbeteren.

**FUNCTIE EISEN**
-----------------

* Sterke kennis van JavaScript en TypeScript en ervaring met moderne frontendframeworks zoals **React, Angular, Vue of Svelte.**
* Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met een backendtaal zoals Java, C#/.NET of Python. Ervaring met bijvoorbeeld Go of Kotlin is ook bespreekbaar.
* Ervaring met agentic engineering, waarbij je AI-agents inzet voor onder andere het opzetten, refactoren en reviewen van code.
* Je kunt AI-output kritisch beoordelen en bent je bewust van verantwoord en zorgvuldig AI-gebruik.
* Je hebt oog voor codekwaliteit, performance, toegankelijkheid en onderhoudbaarheid.
* *Pré: ervaring met moderne testtools zoals Vitest, Jest, Playwright of Cypress en met meta-frameworks zoals Next.js, Nuxt of Astro en met DevOps/CI/CD.*

**ARBEIDSVOORWAARDEN**
----------------------

* Een brutosalaris tot € 6.100 per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.
* Hybride werken, met ruimte voor flexibiliteit in waar en wanneer je werkt.
* Een elektrische leaseauto, een ov-abonnement of een mobiliteitsbudget.
* Een flexibel arbeidsvoorwaardenbudget van ruim 13% boven op je salaris, vrij te besteden aan bijvoorbeeld extra salaris of vakantiedagen.
* Minimaal 20 tot maximaal 33 vakantiedagen, waarbij je zelf je gewenste balans bepaalt.
* Een laptop en telefoon naar keuze.
* Een uitstekende pensioenregeling.
* Ruimte en budget voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling.
* Werken in een hecht team van frontendspecialisten, met volop mogelijkheden voor kennisdeling en samenwerking.

**BEDRIJFSPROFIEL**
-------------------

Je komt te werken bij een groeiende IT-organisatie waar technische kwaliteit, innovatie en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. De organisatie werkt aan uiteenlopende softwareprojecten voor verschillende opdrachtgevers en biedt developers de mogelijkheid om regelmatig nieuwe omgevingen, technologieën en uitdagingen te ontdekken. Tegelijkertijd maak je deel uit van een hecht team van specialisten waarin kennisdeling, samenwerking en werkplezier belangrijk zijn. Er is veel ruimte om eigen ideeën in te brengen, nieuwe technologieën te verkennen en jezelf zowel technisch als persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen.

jobs.title: Medior Data Engineer Dienstregeling (Dutch speaking only)
jobs.description:
**Daarom wil je als Medior Data Engineer bij NS werken**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Je bouwt de data waarop NS complexe keuzes rond de dienstregeling, materieel, personeel en energie kan onderbouwen.
* Je werkt aan een flexibel datafundament waarin planningsdata uit verschillende momenten betrouwbaar samenkomt. Technische diepgang waarmee je bijdraagt aan de treindienst van de toekomst.
* Je krijgt ruimte om je te ontwikkelen in het dienstregelingsdomein en te werken met de nieuwste technologie, terwijl je vanaf het begin verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor kwaliteit, testen en productie.

Jouke: "Je leert hier ontzettend snel, omdat je met moderne cloud-technologie werkt binnen een team dat elkaar scherp houdt. De uitdaging zit 'm in de complexiteit van de keten: alles hangt met alles samen, dus je moet goed kunnen schakelen tussen techniek en de business erachter."

**Dit ga je doen als Medior Data Engineer Dienstregeling**
----------------------------------------------------------

Als Medior Data Engineer maak je planningsdata toegankelijk en betrouwbaar. Jouw data-objecten vormen de basis waarop andere BI-teams informatieproducten en analyses bouwen. Daarmee help je NS om de dienstregeling steeds beter af te stemmen op de wensen van reizigers, eisen van de overheid en de beschikbaarheid van personeel, materieel en energie.

Je werkt end-to-end: van refinement tot bronontsluiting , testen, code review en productie. Je hoeft nog niet iedere complexe oplossing zelfstandig te beheersen. Wel neem je medior ervaring mee, werk je graag hands-on en wil je blijven leren.

Dankzij jouw gevoel voor kwaliteit en eigenaarschap ben jij van waarde bij het:

* bouwen van robuuste Snowflake-code met controles op verwerking, foutafhandeling en datakwaliteit;
* maken en onderhouden van een Datavault 2.0
* reviewen en testen van eigen code en die van collega’s, met aandacht voor risico en afbreukrisico;
* zichtbaar maken van afhankelijkheden en samen met de Product Owner prioriteren over de hele dataketen;
* automatiseren van deployments, werken met versiebeheer en in productie nemen van oplossingen;
* ontsluiten van databronnen in de Azure cloud en opwerken van data met Databricks;
* initiëren en implementeren van verbeteringen, of deze gericht overdragen aan een ander team.

**Hier ga je werken**
---------------------

Je werkt op loopafstand van Utrecht Centraal bij Data, Innovatie & Analyse. Binnen cluster Prestatieregie helpt jouw team NS om datagedreven te sturen op een steeds betere dienstregeling.

Je komt in een multidisciplinair Scrum-team met Data Engineers, een informatieanalist, Product Owner en Scrum Master. Het team werkt hard, viert successen en houdt elkaar inhoudelijk scherp. Je krijgt ervaren collega’s om van te leren én ruimte om zelf een duidelijke visie in te brengen.

Bij NS vinden we diversiteit en inclusie belangrijk. Verschillende perspectieven maken onze samenwerking en oplossingen beter. Wat jouw achtergrond, leeftijd, gender, culturele identiteit, beperking of levensovertuiging ook is: we zijn vooral benieuwd naar jouw vakmanschap, motivatie en kijk op deze functie.

**Dit zijn de functie-eisen**
-----------------------------

We zoeken geen kandidaat die ieder onderdeel al volledig beheerst. Herken je jezelf in de kern van het profiel en wil je je verder ontwikkelen? Dan nodigen we je uit om te reageren.

* Je werkt en denkt op hbo- of wo-niveau. Dit kan blijken uit opleiding, werkervaring of een combinatie daarvan.
* Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring als Data Engineer in een ETL-, BI- of datawarehouseomgeving en hebt zelfstandig datapipelines gebouwd.
* Je hebt praktische ervaring met Snowflake en met het verwerken van grote of complexe datavolumes.
* Je hebt ervaring met Datavault 2.0.
* Je hebt gewerkt in een Agile, Scrum, DevOps- of Kanbanomgeving en kent versiebeheer, deployment automation, testen en productiegang.
* Je maakt kwaliteit zichtbaar in je werk: je bouwt controles in, reviewt code en weegt risico’s af in plaats van alleen nieuwe functionaliteit op te leveren.
* Je bent kritisch, neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor sprintresultaten en je bent een finisher zodat alles netjes achterblijft voor de volgende feature. Je bent bereid om te designen, plannen, bouwen, testen, deployen en documenteren

Ervaring met Databricks is mooi meegenomen. Mis je kennis van een van deze tools, maar heb je een sterke basis en leer je snel? Ook dan horen we graag van je.

Bij NS vinden we het belangrijk dat we elkaar durven aanspreken en ons kunnen uitspreken. Voor deze functie betekent dit dat je verantwoordelijkheid neemt, actief samenwerkt en verbeteringen niet laat liggen.

**Dit zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden**
----------------------------------

Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Je maakt deel uit van een organisatie die midden in de maatschappij staat en Nederland in beweging brengt. Maar als 1 van de grootste werkgevers van Nederland hebben we je zoveel meer te bieden. Voor deze functie is dit onder andere:

* Een salaris tussen € 3.743,- en € 6.491,- bruto per maand (schaal 60) (o.b.v. 36-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.
* Een 36- urige werkweek.
* 144 uur wettelijk verlof (o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband) + extra verlof afhankelijk van leeftijd (minimaal een week).
* Een professionele, output-gestuurde werkomgeving waar gewerkt wordt volgens ‘het nieuwe werken’. Vrijheid en eigen inbreng staan daarbij centraal.
* De mogelijkheid om 3 christelijke feestdagen om te ruilen voor 3 niet-christelijke feestdagen.
* 3% eindejaarsuitkering, 8% vakantietoeslag en een uitstekende pensioenregeling.
* Je treinreizen in de 2e klas zijn gratis; in de 1e klas reizen kan tegen een kleine eigen bijdrage.
* Je gezin reist gratis in de daluren.
* Korting op Europese treinreizen zodra je 1 jaar bij NS werkt.
* De mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en flexibele werktijden (in overleg).
* Professionel

jobs.title: Environmental Protection Specialist
jobs.description:
Summary

See below for important information regarding this job.

Duties

Help

If selected at the GS-09 level, duties will be performed in a developmental capacity
Performs direct compliance responsibilities for physically stored hazardous materials at the DLA Disposition Services site to include a 90-day hazardous storage facility and/or a Conforming Storage Facility for all hazardous materials generated.
Coordinates a Conforming Storage Facility for all Hazardous materials generated throughout a state area or equivalent.
Determines when permits are required, prepares or coordinates the preparation of the applications and resolves any problems to ensure that permits are obtained at the right time.
Performs tasks related to all technical aspects of the environmental disposal program at full-service sites including Hubs, retrogrades, special contracts or unusual waste streams.
Ensure the facility remains or comes into regulatory compliance.
Conducts pre-receipt inspections of hazardous materials and waste generation.
Provides technical guidance to field office materials handling personnel performing actual receiving/warehousing functions.
Establishes and furnishes guidance to sales and reutilization personnel pertaining to the RTD/Sales of hazardous materials and waste.
Furnishes guidance to DLA Disposition Services personnel pertaining to all applicable environmental regulations and policies. Implements and administers an Environmental Management System (EMS) for designated site(s).

Requirements

Help

Conditions of employment

Must be a U.S. citizen
Tour of Duty: Set Schedule
Security Requirements: Non-Critical Sensitive
Appointment is subject to the completion of a favorable suitability or fitness determination, where reciprocity cannot be applied; unfavorably adjudicated background checks will be grounds for removal.
Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA): Non-Exempt
Selective Service Requirement: Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered or exempt from Selective Service.
Recruitment Incentives: Not Authorized
Bargaining Unit Status: No
Pre-Employment Physical: Required
Selectees are required to have a REAL ID or other acceptable identification documents to access certain federal facilities. See https://www.tsa.gov/real-id for more information.
Term Appointment: May be converted to permanent (See Next Steps section)
This is an obligated position and occupancy is subject to the return of former incumbent. If former incumbent fails to return to the position, occupancy may become permanent.

Qualifications

To qualify for an Environmental Protection Specialist, your resume and supporting documentation must support:

Specialized Experience: One year of specialized experience that equipped you with the particular competencies to successfully perform the duties of the position, and that is typically in or related to the position to be filled. To qualify at the GS-11 level, applicants must possess one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-09 level or equivalent under other pay systems in the Federal service, military or private sector. To qualify at the GS-09 level, applicants must possess one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-07 level or equivalent under other pay systems in the Federal service, military or private sector. Applicants must meet eligibility requirements including minimum qualifications, and any other regulatory requirements by the cut-off/closing date of the announcement. Creditable specialized experience includes:

Gs-09

Utilizing and interpreting the practices and procedures for receipt, storage, sale and reutilization and ultimate disposal activities related to environmentally sensitive material and waste
Understanding and following the principles of the Environmental Program by providing guidance and assistance to generator personnel, DLA Disposition Services personnel, and customer/contracted personnel in support of the mission requirements.
Appling various local, state and federal rules, regulations and laws related to the receipt, storage, handling, transportation, sale and other disposal requirements of hazardous and toxic materials and waste.

GS-11:

Performing tasks related to the oversight of disposal contracts.
Performing inspections of materials, containers and storage facilities to determine their nature and condition.

C. Combination: Combinations of successfully completed post-high school education and experience may be used to meet total qualification requirements for grade levels GS-11 and GS-09, and may be computed by first determining the applicant's total qualifying experience as a percentage of the experience required for the grade level; then determining the applicant's education as a percentage of the education required for the grade level; and then adding the two percentages. The total percentages must equal at least 100 percent to qualify an applicant for that grade level. Only graduate education in excess of the amount required for the next lower grade level may be used to qualify applicants for positions at grade GS-11 and GS-09.

Education Substitution: Such education must demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work. Education must be from a college or university accredited by an organization approved by the U.S. Department of Education. See http://ope.ed.gov/accreditation/Search.aspx. If using education to meet basic qualifications, YOU MUST SUBMIT A TRANSCRIPT as supplemental documentation. To qualify based on education in lieu of specialized experience, you must possess:
GS-09: a master's or equivalent graduate degree or 2 full years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to such a degree or LL.B. or J.D., if related.
GS-11: A Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree or 3 full years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to such a degree or LL.M., if related.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

To be found well-qualified as an ICTAP applicant, experience should include: applying local, state, and federal requirements governing the receipt, storage, handling, transportation, sale, and disposal of hazardous and toxic materials and waste; knowledge of chemical properties, contaminants, waste characterization, labeling, storage compatibility, and safe processing procedures for hazardous materials; inspecting materials, containers, and storage areas; identifying unsafe or noncompliant conditions; and ensuring timely corrective actions; ability to provide technical guidance to generators, field personnel, customers, and contractors while maintaining accurate receipt, inventory, accountability, and disposition documentation within required time frames.

Physical Demands

Performance of work requires frequent inspections of generator collection points and areas, field office warehousing facilities

and observing customer/contractor on site operations which requires extended walking and standing.

UWork Environment

Work involves regular and recurring exposure to adverse weather conditions, and conditions within hazardous collection and

storage facilities. This may require the use of limited safety equipment such as hard hats, safety shoes and other similar

safety apparel.

Education

Are you using your education to qualify? You MUST provide transcripts or other documentation to support your educational claims. Unless otherwise stated: Unofficial transcripts are acceptable at time of application.

GRADUATE EDUCATION: One academic year of graduate education is considered to be the number of credits hours that your graduate school has determined to represent one academic year of full-time study. Such study may have been performed on a full-time or part-time basis. If you cannot obtain your graduate school's definition of one year of graduate study, 18 semester hours (or 27 quarter hours) should be considered as satisfying the requirement for one year of full-time graduate study.

FOREIGN EDUCATION: If you are using education completed in foreign colleges or universities to meet the qualification requirements, you must show that the education credentials have been evaluated by a private organization that specializes in interpretation of foreign education programs and such education has been deemed equivalent to that gained in an accredited U.S. education program; or full credit has been given for the courses at a U.S. accredited college or university.

Additional information

As required by 5 C.F.R.

302.106, DLA will provide Section 508 conformant ICT to employees with disabilities. All ICT interfaces with the public related to vacancy announcements and career transition opportunities must conform to the applicable requirements in the current ICT Standards and Guidelines (36 C.F.R.
1194).

For Important General Applicant Information and Definitions go to:
http://www.dla.mil/portals/104/documents/careers/GenAppInfoDef.pdf

Reemployed Annuitants:
This position does not meet criteria for appointment of Reemployed Annuitants. The DoD criteria for hiring Reemployed Annuitants can be found at: https://www.esd.whs.mil/Portals/54/Documents/DD/issuances/140025/140025_vol300.PDF

The Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) is committed to maintaining a safe, drug-free workplace. All DLA employees are required to refrain from illegal drug use on and off duty. DLA conducts pre-employment, reasonable suspicion, post-accident, and random drug testing.

Applicants tentatively selected for employment in testing designated positions will undergo a urinalysis to screen for illegal drug use prior to appointment. Refusal to undergo testing or testing positive for illegal drugs will result in withdrawal of the tentative job offer and a six-month denial of employment with DLA from the date of the drug test. Employees in drug testing designated positions are subject to random drug testing. A negative drug test result must be received by HR within 30 calendar days after the EOD (i.e., start date). The selectee's inability successfully pass; or refusal to conduct the test may result in: 1) the tentative or FJO being withdrawn during the recruitment process; or 2) subsequently being removed from Federal service for failure to meet a condition of employment. You may be required to sign a "Drug Test Statement of Understanding" if you are selected for this position.

The DLA drug testing panel tests for the following substances: marijuana, cocaine, opiates, heroin, phencyclidine, amphetamines, methamphetamines, fentanyl, norfentanyl, methylenedioxymethamphetamine (MDMA), methylenedioxyamphetamine (MDA), and opioids.

ADVISORY: Use of cannabidiol (CBD) products may result in a positive drug test for marijuana. DLA employees are subject to Federal law and under Federal law, Marijuana is illegal
.

jobs.title: Environmental Scientist III
jobs.description:
Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM is seeking an experienced Environmental Scientist III / Senior Environmental Scientist
to join our Environmental Remediation Practice in Richmond, California
.

The successful candidate will provide technical leadership and project coordination for environmental investigation, remediation, groundwater monitoring, compliance, and emergency response projects throughout Northern California and the western United States. This position will support a diverse portfolio of industrial, energy, transportation, municipal, and commercial clients while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams of scientists, engineers, geologists, and technical specialists.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience managing environmental field programs, coordinating subcontractors and laboratories, overseeing health and safety compliance, managing environmental data, and preparing technical and regulatory deliverables.

This position will be based in Richmond, California, with opportunities to support projects throughout Northern California and the western United States.

Responsibilities

Technical and Project Leadership

Lead environmental investigation, monitoring, remediation, and compliance projects from planning through execution.
Coordinate field schedules, staffing, subcontractors, laboratory services, equipment, and site logistics.
Develop and implement work plans, sampling plans, health and safety documentation, and project-specific field procedures.
Support project managers with project planning, budgeting, scheduling, resource forecasting, and client communications.
Identify project risks and develop solutions to achieve project objectives while maintaining quality, schedule, and budget commitments.

Groundwater Monitoring and Remediation

Plan and oversee groundwater, soil, sediment, and waste characterization programs.
Manage groundwater monitoring events and environmental sampling activities.
Coordinate remedial investigations, corrective action programs, groundwater treatment systems, and in-situ remediation efforts.
Evaluate environmental data and support development of remedial strategies and technical recommendations.
Ensure field activities are performed in accordance with project requirements and applicable regulations.

Environmental Compliance

Support environmental compliance programs for industrial, infrastructure, remediation, and construction projects.
Conduct environmental inspections, audits, and compliance assessments.
Monitor project activities for compliance with permits, mitigation measures, Environmental Protection Plans (EPPs), and Storm Water Pollution Prevention Plans (SWPPPs).
Coordinate with regulatory agencies, contractors, and stakeholders to support permitting and environmental compliance objectives.

Health and Safety

Implement and enforce site-specific Health and Safety Plans (HASPs), Job Safety Analyses (JSAs), and company safety procedures.
Lead daily safety meetings, hazard assessments, and pre-task planning activities.
Support atmospheric monitoring, radiological monitoring, confined-space activities, and other specialized health and safety requirements.
Promote a strong safety culture through leadership, mentoring, and continuous improvement.

Technical Reporting and Data Management

Prepare and review technical reports, groundwater monitoring reports, regulatory submittals, and field documentation.
Perform QA/QC reviews of environmental data, field records, and project deliverables.
Manage environmental databases and electronic reporting platforms, including EQuIS and GeoTracker.
Support data validation, interpretation, and presentation of technical findings to clients and regulatory agencies.

Team Development

Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior environmental professionals.
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams including environmental scientists, geologists, engineers, biologists, technicians, and subcontractors.
Support staff development through field training, technical mentoring, and knowledge sharing initiatives.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Geology, Biology, Environmental Engineering, Natural Resources, or a related field and 4+ years environmental consulting or related professional experience (groundwater monitoring, environmental sampling, remediation field activities, and environmental compliance programs, leading project teams, coordinating complex environmental projects, experience preparing technical reports and regulatory deliverables, etc.) or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
A valid driver’s license is required, along with the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check in accordance with company policy.
Employment is contingent upon successfully completing a pre-employment background check and drug screen.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting California environmental remediation programs, including DTSC, RWQCB, and GeoTracker reporting requirements.
Experience at refinery, chemical, manufacturing, terminal, energy, or other industrial facilities, including CERCLA, RCRA, corrective action, and groundwater remediation programs.
Experience managing subcontractors, coordinating multidisciplinary project teams, and supporting emergency response and disaster recovery.
Experience with complex groundwater monitoring and reporting, environmental site investigations, remediation, compliance, and regulatory reporting.
Proficiency in EQuIS, GeoTracker, environmental database management, QA/QC, data validation, technical report preparation, SWPPP compliance, HASPs, JSAs, atmospheric and radiological monitoring.
Relevant training and certifications: current OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER, OSHA 8-Hour HAZWOPER Refresher, OSHA Site Supervisor Training, RCRA Hazardous Waste Management Training, Radiation Safety or Radiological Monitoring Training, Confined Space Entry Training, and First Aid/CPR Certification.

Additional Information

AECOM is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship now or in the future for this position.
Position may involve local and regional travel, field assignments, and periodic overnight travel.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What Makes AECOM a Great Place To Work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Lead – Environmental Assessment
jobs.description:
Take Your Environmental Career to the Next Level

Kleinfelder, a Forbes' Top Employer for Engineers in North America, is committed to a people-first culture, technical excellence, and creating opportunities where employees can thrive!

Are you ready to be challenged, make a difference, and experience professional growth in your career? Kleinfelder's Environmental team is looking for you! From environmental planning, permitting, remediation, and site characterization to chemical data management and hydrogeology, Kleinfelder offers a variety of services designed to provide technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions.

Step into Your New Role

Kleinfelder's Southern California Area is seeking a Senior Technical Lead to provide environmental assessment and investigation technical support for our region
. This candidate will lead project technical execution and will work on exciting large local transportation and municipal agency contracts to contribute to a real positive impact on our community. The candidate must have an extensive site characterization assessment and remediation background. This person will be based out of our downtown Los Angeles office.

Responsibilities

Technical

Oversee environmental site assessments, soil, soil gas, and groundwater assessments, feasibility studies, remedial action plans, remediation system design/operation, construction, multi-media compliance efforts, and other supporting technical studies
Perform advanced technical writing and detailed review of data/reports
Experience/working-knowledge with Department of Toxic Substances Control and Regional Water Quality Control Boards
Understanding of US EPA RCRA and TSCA regulations
Perform data analyses in support of scientific investigations and engineered solutions

Project Management

Oversee large programs and multiple projects simultaneously within scope, schedule, and budget
High level of competency in environmental consulting– including financial management, client management, and risk management
Manage a full project team
Front-line client interaction/communications
Accountable for Quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) on project deliverables

Mentorship

Staff supervision and team leadership
Career and technical mentoring and training for junior staff
Assisting in loss prevention and risk management

As a Senior Technical Lead and role model, this leadership position requires an excellent attitude and an ability to communicate and effectively manage a very talented bench of internal and external team members/staff. Additionally, this individual will be expected to take a leadership role in business development.

Experience & Academic Requirements

12+ years of experience in environmental consulting, in-depth knowledge of California regulations, and the ability to provide high-end technical advisory support - 15+ years is highly preferred.
Minimum of 10 years of project management experience with multi-disciplinary environmental compliance projects and proven responsibility with scope / schedule / budget.
BS (MS preferred) from an accredited college/university with a major in environmental engineering, geology, or related field is required.
Professional licensure (PE or PG) or the ability to obtain within 3 months required

Competencies & Skills

Excellent technical writing and editing skills
Well-developed oral, presentation, and interpersonal skills
Strong customer service emphasis and solution-oriented delivery
Leadership and strong ability to work in a collaborative environment
Ability to work under pressure and meet timelines
Conscientious and high attention to detail
Good judgment and sound decision-making skills
Experience in providing leadership to diverse project teams on high-pressure, high-visibility projects

POSITION CONDITIONS

This position is performed in an office and field environment.
Candidate must pass a medical surveillance that includes drug screening.
Ability to lift up to 25lbs.
Up to 20% of time may be dedicated to field activities in varying environmental conditions including inclement weather.
Some night and weekend work may be required for this position.
May periodically require travel and stays outside of the greater Los Angeles area.
Personal vehicle use for travel to / from project site is expected.

Following an offer, candidates will be required to satisfactorily complete employment reference checks, verification of professional licensure and/or educational credentials, a motor vehicle report (MVR), and a comprehensive background check.

Move Forward with Kleinfelder:
 Kleinfelder and its’ subsidiaries and affiliates, has been connecting great people to the best work since 1961. We are engineers, scientists, and construction professionals providing solutions that improve our clients’ transportation, water, energy, and other private infrastructure. As a responsive, cross-disciplinary team of bright, curious, and innovative problem-solvers, we are dedicated to doing the right thing, every day, on every project from over 110 offices in the US, Canada, and Australia. Connecting great people to the best work is our purpose – together, we deliver. 

Progress with an Employer that Values You

Kleinfelder, and its’ subsidiaries and affiliates, is an inclusive organization free from discrimination. We are a stronger organization when we are a diverse workforce and believe that through diversity, equity, and inclusion comes creativity, innovation, and unity. We are proud to offer the following: 

Benefits:
Kleinfelder, and its’ subsidiaries and affiliates, offers an excellent compensation and benefits package, including: medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(k) plan, and paid holidays.  The expected salary range for the position is displayed in accordance with the California Pay Transparency Law.  Final agreed upon compensation is based upon individual qualifications and experience. Salary Range: $131,248 - $182,874.

Career Development:

jobs.description:
Temp Senior Research Associate, Investigative Toxicology

Revolution Medicines is a clinical-stage precision oncology company focused on developing novel targeted therapies to inhibit frontier targets in RAS-addicted cancers. The company’s R&D pipeline comprises RAS(ON) Inhibitors designed to suppress diverse oncogenic variants of RAS proteins, and RAS Companion Inhibitors for use in combination treatment strategies. As a new member of the Revolution Medicines team, you will join other outstanding scientists in a tireless commitment to patients with cancers harboring mutations in the RAS signaling pathway.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Research Associate to support laboratory research activities focused on the development and execution of investigative toxicology (iTox) predictive assays and workflows to enable improved safety translation to the clinic. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of the technical needs in a lab as well as significant hands-on experience with standard/bespoke cell culture and in vitro cell biology techniques. Further, the successful candidate will:

Develop novel approach methods (NAMs) including predictive 2D/3D models for nonclinical safety assessments.
Independently perform experiments related to in vitro/ex vivo 2D/3D assays using lab techniques that include cell viability/cell death, flow cytometry, primary cell culture, animal sample processing, molecular and cell isolation, immunofluorescence, plate-based reporter assays and ELISA/Luminex
Support in vivo study design, data analysis, study coordination and sample management
Analyze, interpret and accurately document assay/study results in an electronic lab notebook or other technical reporting formats
Work independently and collaboratively in a team to ensure timely and accurate data analysis and communication to support decision-making and contribute to high-quality study reports.
Support the operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of lab instruments and contribute to the evaluation and adoption of new technologies for enhanced toxicity prediction, compound screening, and development of translational safety biomarkers.
Manage day-to-day experimental/study related activities in the lab and work effectively with Contract Research Organizations (CROs), RevMed study operations, internal scientists and subject matter experts (SMEs).
Maintain a safe and organized lab environment and support development and/or review of protocols, SOPs, policies, and guidelines.

Required Skills, Experience, and Education:

Bachelor/Master’s degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences or a related scientific discipline, with 5+ of relevant industry experience or 3+ years of postgraduate working experience.
Hands-on experience in operating and maintaining cell culture and standard lab instruments.
Experience maintaining lab environment, lab infrastructure and sample management.
Experience with animal sample processing and advanced cell culture techniques for immortalized cell lines, primary cells (including PBMCs) and/or iPSC cells.
Cell and molecular biology methods, including flow cytometry, Luminex/MSD, ELISA, cell viability/death assays.
Ability to conduct multiple laboratory and project tasks efficiently.
Ability to work in a team-oriented environment with flexibility.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, excellent record-keeping skills, and being able to adapt to a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.

Preferred Skills:

Experience working with small molecules and targeted oncology therapeutics of all modalities.
Experience working in a matrixed team environment at a biotech/pharma company or CRO.
3D assays, data analytics/ in silico experience is a plus.

This is a contract position that will be employed through a third-party recruiting agency. The agency will provide the pay range, which will be based on several factors, including job-related skills, experience, market conditions, and relevant education or training.

Do you have a passion for protecting the environment and ensuring the sustainability of our natural resources? The Central Coast Water Board is seeking an experienced, knowledgeable, and motivated Environmental Scientist to join our team in San Luis Obispo, California. In this position, you will play a critical role as our region’s scientific expert on surface water quality issues with a focus on developing total maximum daily loads (TMDLs) and accompanying implementation plans to address the complex impacts of pesticides, nutrients, toxins, and other pollutants to water quality and human health.

The Environmental Scientist will focus on developing TMDL projects using new or emerging science for pesticides and associated toxicity, nutrients, biological indicators (e.g., bacteria indicators, harmful algal bloom species and associated algal toxins, benthic invertebrate species, bioaccumulation in sport fish and prey fish, etc.), and molecular detection of biological indicators. This position will study the toxicity of pollutants to assess their impact on water quality and aquatic ecosystems. The Environmental Scientist will also be tasked with reviewing peer-reviewed scientific research and designing novel approaches to develop numeric thresholds for pesticides, nutrients, and other toxic pollutants for TMDLs, planning documents, or other regulatory mechanisms that protect water quality. Applicants with particular interest in pesticides and pesticide-related-toxicity are strongly encouraged to apply.

The Environmental Scientist will also be responsible for supporting water quality data assessments that inform the federal Clean Water Act section 303(d) List and section 305(b) Report.

At the Central Coast Water Board, we're committed to protecting and improving the water quality in our region. Your work will be critical in helping us achieve our mission of preserving and protecting the natural resources in our region.

jobs.title: Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
APTIM is seeking a motivated entry-level Environmental Scientist to support our portfolio of federal environmental investigation and remediation projects. Projects commonly involve the investigation and remediation of sites with groundwater or soil impacted by chlorinated solvents, petroleum, radiological contaminants, or emerging compounds. The successful candidate will work under the supervision of project managers and partner with other engineers, scientists, geologists, risk assessors, and health physicists.

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities:**

* Assist with the collection, documentation, and organization of field data to support project objectives.
* Contribute to the preparation of project work plans and deliverables.
* Assist with the development of technical scopes of work and cost estimates for proposal efforts.
* Develop and maintain spreadsheets, dashboards, and data-tracking tools.
* Assist in the management, analysis, and interpretation of environmental data using statistical analysis and data visualization tools.
* Identify and evaluate environmental risks and recommend remediation strategies to support compliance with federal, state, and local regulations.
* Adhere to established health and safety policies and procedures and execute work in a safe and conscientious manner.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in environmental science or a related scientific discipline (completed or in progress).
* Relevant internship, research, or academic project experience involving environmental investigation, water or wastewater treatment, sustainability, or ecological conservation (0–2 years).
* Strong interest in environmental remediation, field investigations, treatment systems, and environmental compliance.
* Must have strong written and oral communication skills.
* Willingness to learn field sampling methods, equipment operation, and environmental data collection procedures.
* Ability to perform essential field duties, including walking on uneven terrain, lifting and carrying field equipment, and working outdoors in varying weather conditions.
* Ability to wear and use required PPE.
* Ability to travel to work sites, including overnight travel.
* Valid driver's license.
* Must be a U.S. citizen or authorized to work on federal contracts.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Completion of 40-hour OSHA HAZWOPER training.
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar tools) to support technical communication, analytical tasks, research, and efficient project execution. Upon hire, employees are expected to use these tools in accordance with approved company guidelines.

**About APTIM**

APTIM enhances the quality of the environment, wellbeing of people, resilience of communities, and opportunity for employees to make a difference, not just a living. A leading professional solutions firm, we specialize in environmental, sustainability, resilience, and infrastructure solutions. Our team of experts provide these integrated solutions for forward-thinking government agencies, commercial and industrial clients, and energy customers. Together, we create sustainable and resilient communities for all.

What you can expect from APTIM:

* Work that is worthy of your time and talent
* Respect and flexibility to live a full life at work and at home
* Dogged determination to deliver for our clients and communities
* A voice in making our company better
* Investment into your personal and professional development

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay range for this position is $33.00 to $40.00 per hour Compensation depends on several factors including: experience, education, key skills, geographic location of the position, client requirements, external market competitiveness, and internal equity among other employees within APTIM.

**Employee Benefits**

APTIM Federal Services, llc is committed to providing an extensive range of benefits that protect and promote the health and financial well-being of our employees and their families through the APTIM Benefits Marketplace https://aptim.makeityoursource.com/.

* Medical, vision, and dental insurance: Through the marketplace, our employees can choose benefits from five metallic levels and several carriers to find the right benefits that work for them in their location.
* Company paid and optional Life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance
* Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity coverage
* Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave (eligibility based on company policy and applicable law)
* 401(k) APTIM offers three 401k plans through the Aon Pooled Employer Plan (PEP). The specific plan you are eligible for depends on the business unit you are in. The details of the largest plan are found here:

* + APTIM 401(k) Guide
  + APTIM - Helpful Documents

**Watch our video:**  
**About APTIM - In Pursuit of Better**

### **Job Description and Duties**

Are you looking to be a part of a dynamic team of conservation-minded scientists working to protect fish and wildlife resources in the redwood and Douglas fir forests, oak woodlands, chaparral, and grasslands of the San Francisco Bay Area? The Department of Fish and Wildlife's Wildfire Resiliency Program is seeking a motivated professional to work as a Senior Environmental Scientist Specialist reviewing and evaluating vegetation management and fuel reduction projects, and Timber Emergencies and Exemptions by analyzing consequences of proposed activities, attending site visits and inspections, preparing written reports and recommendations for the conservation of fish and wildlife resources, assessing the application of law, regulation and policy, conducting listed and sensitive species consultations, and preparing any related Lake and Streambed Alteration Agreements and Incidental Take Permits.

The incumbent works in close collaboration with other Environmental Scientists and Senior Environmental Scientists, and with other state agencies. Under the direction of a Senior Environmental Scientist (Supervisory) the incumbent represents the region and acts as the staff lead and provides consultative advice when working with applicants, local, state and federal agencies, stakeholders, and the general public. Public contacts made in the course of this work are sensitive and involve a wide variety of special interest groups.

Performance of specified activities will require an in-depth knowledge of administrative procedures, Department policies, applicable environmental laws and regulations, and ecological principles to protect fish and wildlife resources. Strong written and oral communication skills are necessary. Problem-solving, organizational skills and a positive attitude towards teamwork are essential. Fieldwork in rugged terrain is required.  
  
  

**Personal Leave Program:** Effective July 1, 2025, state employees are subject to temporary salary reductions ranging from 2% to 4.62% in exchange for Personal Leave Program (PLP) hours. Please note that the salary ranges listed in this Job Control may not reflect these reductions associated with the 2025 Personal Leave Program.

  

Please follow the link for more information regarding the 2025 Personal Leave program:

  

Personal Leave Program - Human Resources - CalHR.

This position may be eligible for a telework opportunity in accordance with departmental policies and operational needs. Beginning July 1, 2026, employees will be required to work in-person at least four (4) days per week in alignment with Executive Order N-22-25. Additional in-office days may be required based on operational needs.

  
  

Link to Class Title Exam: Senior Environmental Scientist (Specialist)*/***Exam Bulletin**

**This position is a 12-month Limited Term (LT) and may be extended up to 24 months or become permanent.**

  

During this 12-month Limited Term assignment, you will receive full health, dental, and vision benefits! You will also earn State Service and accrue monthly leave credits.

You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**.

### **Working Conditions**

The position requires the use of a computer for several hours each day, the completion of office tasks that require sitting, standing, and walking to other locations; attendance at meetings and participation in conference calls. The position may require frequent travel throughout the State including overnight travel, early mornings, and late nights (up to 20%). Must be able to work unusual and/or long hours; spend multiple days in the field assessing habitat conditions in inclement weather; walk in and through rough terrain; and hike over uneven, steep, wet, and rough terrain with no vehicle access. Must possess a valid driver’s license and be able to safely drive a motor vehicle (with and without four-wheel drive) off highway and over rough terrain. Must operate an all-terrain vehicle (ATV); and office equipment (computers, copies/scanners, telephones, iPads, global positioning system [GPS] units, etc.). The position requires the use of personal protective equipment, including protective footwear, hardhat, gloves, helmet, and eye protection. The position may require the incumbent to wear a uniform identifying the employee as Department staff.

This position is located at the CDFW, Bay Delta Region field office in Santa Rosa, California. The position may be eligible for a telework option per the requirements set by CDFW and the State of California.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

*“I've been with AECOM for over a decade, and when I reflect on why I stay with the company it is because of workplace culture and the nature of our projects. Working on impactful community-shaping projects with unique and diverse challenges, having opportunities for meaningful career progression, and being a part of a caring, close-knit team that supports each other through life's ups and downs.” –* ***Alix Chinnery, Associate Director - Environment, Perth, WA***

**Come grow with us.**

AECOM's environmental practice is dedicated to helping industries, clients and governments meet their environmental responsibilities while protecting the natural environment. We provide advisory and technical services to ensure compliance, manage impacts, and reduce risks, including obtaining permits and approvals, decommissioning and restoring contaminated sites, and tackling climate change challenges and resilience. We focus on preserving habitats, water quality, stakeholder engagement and cultural resources, promoting a holistic approach to environmental impact management at every project stage.

**Everyone belongs at AECOM.**

We’re committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging - because great ideas come from diverse perspectives. AECOM is proud to be a **Fortune 500 Most Admired Company**, a **WGEA Employer of Choice for Gender Equality**, #**Work180 Equitable Workplace Awards 2025 Winner** and an **AWEI Bronze Tier LGBTQ+ Inclusive Employer**.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for a passionate Graduate Environmental Planner / Scientist to join our **Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA)** teamin Newcastle.

At AECOM, our Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) team is helping deliver some of the most transformational projects in Australia – from renewable energy and transmission projects, to major road, rail, water and industrial developments. We combine innovative technologies with decades of expertise to deliver robust, easy-to-understand analyses that achieve compliance, support clients’ Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) objectives, and create meaningful change for communities.

**How you'll make a difference:**

* Apply your environmental science, planning, or engineering qualifications to real-world challenges.
* Work with multi-disciplinary teams of scientists, planners, engineers, drafters, project administrators and contractors in a fast-paced consulting environment.
* Develop skills in environmental assessment across renewable energy, water, and transport sectors, as well as in navigating approval pathways under Commonwealth, State, and local frameworks.
* Support ESG initiatives by engaging with communities and key stakeholders.
* Embed sustainability and resilience outcomes within projects.

You’ll have opportunities to collaborate across Australia, New Zealand and globally, with access to a strong pipeline of projects and a network of mentors to help you shape your career.

**What our Graduate Program offers:**

* **Graduate Introduction:** Kickstart connections with peers and leaders.
* **Essential Consulting Skills:** Master core consulting skills from day one.
* **Networking and Learning:** Grow your network and industry know-how.
* **Mentoring and Career Support:** Receive guidance from experienced professionals.
* **Learning from Experts:** Learn directly from industry leaders and specialists.
* **Flexible Work Options:** Work in a way that fits your life and wellbeing.
* **Career Pathways:** Get support to progress and step confidently into your next role.

For more information, visit our Early Careers website.

 **Qualifications**  

* **Graduate Attributes:** We’re seeking graduates with strong communication and teamwork skills, a proactive and adaptable mindset, and a commitment to professionalism and integrity.
* **Bachelor’s Degree:** You must be in your final year or completed a Bachelor’s or Postgraduate degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Planning, Environmental Engineering.
* **Graduate Year:** You must have completed your studies and have graduated before starting the program.
* **Commencement:** You must be able to commence work by February 2027. We are open to mid-year finishers who are able to commence by July 2027.
* **Working Rights:** You must have full working rights to work in Australia before applying. We do accept candidates with student and graduate visas.

  
**Additional Information**

**Our Recruitment Process**

* **Submit Your Application:** Complete the job application, uploading your resume, cover letter and the latest copy of your academic transcripts as one single document.
* **Interview:** Attend a face-to-face interview at your local office.

*Applications are reviewed as they come in, and the role may close earlier than expected, so if this opportunity sounds like you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.*

**What sets us apart?**

We are the trusted global infrastructure leader.

Across the globe, we partner with our clients in the public and private sectors to solve their most complex challenges, pioneer innovative solutions and deliver a better world.

Our reputation is recognised globally. We are named the world’s top design firm and ranked #1 in Transportation, General Building, and Environmental Engineering by Engineering News-Record in 2025.

We are also honoured to be listed among Fortune’s “World’s Most Admired Companies” for the twelfth consecutive year and recognised as one of the 2025 World’s Most Ethical Companies by Ethisphere for our commitment to integrity and creating positive impact.

**Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?**

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities, additional health or mental health needs, and/or neurodiverse conditions. If you require any adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Associate Consultant, Air Quality
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position.

**Inviting bright minds**

Do you want to develop your excellence in an open, collaborative and creative culture? We work to create a sustainable future and our inspiring projects and innovative solutions aim to set the standard among our peers. You will join a global company that has been growing successfully since its founding in 1945. Together, we lead and leave a positive impact on societies, companies and people around the world.  
  
Ramboll is seeking an Air Quality Intern to join the firm’s offices in Los Angeles or Irvine, California, or Phoenix, Arizona in Spring/Summer 2027. If you are detail-oriented, self-motivated and enjoy thinking “outside-of-the-box,” please apply! If you can work in a team, apply analytical skills, and are looking to get your hands dirty (literally and figuratively), then you may find Ramboll to be an ideal place to start your career.

 **Job Description**

**You will join our Environment & Health** **department**

As our new Entry Level Air Quality Consultant you will be part of the Air & Climate Service Line within Ramboll’s Environment & Health Division. This group consists of like-minded individuals who are passionate about air and climate issues and assisting Ramboll’s clients with their most challenging problems. The Air & Climate team consults with clients across various industries on a range of topics, including but not limited to emissions estimation, air dispersion modeling, human health risk assessment, climate change, permitting, and compliance.

Your key tasks and responsibilities will be:

* + Preparing emissions calculations
  + Conducting air quality reviews of emissions reduction or control
  + Assisting in preparing major and minor source permit applications and environmental impact reports
  + Critically reviewing and interpreting local, state, and federal environmental regulations

  
**Qualifications**

**Your starting point for constant growth**

From the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company. For this role, we believe your starting point is:

* B.S. or M.S. in Chemical, Mechanical, Civil, or Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, Atmospheric Science, or a science degree with air quality course work with a GPA of 3.5 or higher
* Strong computing skills including high level use of spreadsheets and word processing
* Strong written/verbal communication, problem-solving and organization skills
* Ability to understand and interpret environmental regulations
* Database and GIS skills are preferred but not required

  
**Additional Information**

**Welcome to our Environment & Health division**  
Ramboll develops innovative, scientifically sound solutions that help increase live ability by reducing pollution and restoring natural environments. One of the world’s leading environmental and health consultancies, our bright minds are trusted by clients to manage their most challenging environmental, health and social issues.

**Ramboll in the Americas**

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

**Salary Transparency Statement**

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $64,404 to $80,505 yearly. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

**Where People Flourish**

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do. Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

**How to apply**

Apply online. Atta

**ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENTIST – SAN LUIS OBISPO COAST DISTRICT / MORRO BAY FIELD OFFICE**

The reporting location for this position is the Morro Bay field office. This position will work under the general supervision of the Senior Environmental Scientist (Supervisor).

The Environmental Scientist assists in a variety of responsible professional scientific office and field work. The Environmental Scientist independently performs assigned environmental and natural resource management analysis, research, surveys, and studies; writes final reports; prepares regulatory and compliance documents; enforces environmental law and regulations; prepares non-routine correspondence and answer non-routine questionsfrom the public. ### **Job Description and Duties**

Under the supervision of the Beaver Restoration Program Supervisor, the incumbent will serve as part of the Beaver Restoration Program, implementing beaver restoration projects to support ecosystem conservation, habitat restoration, species conservation, and improve climate change, drought, and wildfire resilience throughout California. Tasks include conducting pre-trapping beaver surveillance, live-trapping and transporting beavers to CDFW's husbandry facilities, daily animal care and pen cleaning during quarantine, beaver translocations and pre- and post-release monitoring of the ecosystem and translocated beavers, maintenance of equipment and animal husbandry facilities, data collection, entry, and management, conducting beaver surveys throughout the state to help determine the current distribution of beavers in California, as well as assisting with image cataloguing in Wildlife Insights to improve the species identification algorithm for species commonly encountered in California’s wetland ecosystems.

**Personal Leave Program:** Effective July 1, 2025, state employees are subject to temporary salary reductions ranging from 2% to 4.62% in exchange for Personal Leave Program (PLP) hours. Must possess valid Driver's License and be able to safely and effectively operate watercraft and Utility Task Vehicles (UTV)s, as well as tow trailers. This job requires daily operation of State vehicles to reach field sites, regular use of kayaks, and occasional operation of UTVs and motorized watercraft. Must wear Department uniform. Field activities may involve strenuous physical activity, hiking long distances in variable weather conditions, and/or camping in remote field sites. jobs.description:
Under general supervision of the Chemical Hygiene Officer at the UCLA Office of Environment, Health & Safety and in accordance
  
with State & Federal regulations, the Chemical Safety Specialist applies technical knowledge to implement, administer, and
  
continuously improve comprehensive laboratory and chemical safety programs supporting research, (indirect) instructional, and
  
operational activities across UCLA. The incumbent provides technical consultation to the faculty, principal investigators,
  
researchers, staff, students, and campus departments regarding chemical, laboratory, and research safety requirements.

  

Responsibilities include developing and implementing Research Safety Management Plans; conducting lab hazard assessments
  
and compliance evaluations; developing and delivering safety training; participating in hazardous materials emergency response;
  
conducting incident investigations; supporting continuous process improvement initiatives; and performing other duties as
  
assigned.

  

Functional assignments may include support for research laboratories, engineering laboratories, medical and health sciences,
  
physical sciences, nanotechnology, hazardous materials, chemical hygiene, laboratory commissioning, laboratory design review,
  
or other specialized research safety programs.

  

This master job description establishes the core duties and responsibilities of the Laboratory Safety Professional position. Specific
  
program assignments, portfolios, departments, and specialized technical responsibilities may be assigned or modified by
  
management based on operational needs, organizational priorities, employee experience, and requirements. Such assignments
  
do not alter the overall classification or primary purpose of the position.

  

This is an in-person position.

  

The incumbent will work under general supervision and independently perform the full range of professional responsibilities

Join an amazing team focused on advancing environmental justice across California.

Seeking someone who is enthusiastic about working with people, who is motivated to support California communities that face the greatest air pollution burdens, and who has excellent writing and organizational skills. This position is focused on, but not exclusive to Northern and Central California communities and requires occasional travel.

No two days look the same in this position. One day you might be analyzing monitoring data or writing a paper; the next, you're in a community meeting listening to residents describe pollution burdens in their neighborhood; the next, you're presenting policy recommendations to the Board.

This Air Pollution Specialist position (APS) plays a key role in implementing Assembly Bill 617 and advancing CARB's statewide strategy to reduce community-scale air pollution by working at the intersection of technical, scientific, legal, and policy topics in air quality. The APS collaborates across California Air Resources Board divisions on emission-reduction strategies and outreach campaigns. They will build relationships with residents and community leaders, and work with air districts, tribal governments, industry, and statewide and local government agencies to find solutions to meet the local priorities.

This work requires someone who is comfortable navigating multiple projects at once, thrives in collaborative environments, and values building trusting relationships with people from many backgrounds, identities, and lived experiences. Core competencies include written and verbal communication, collaboration, technical fluency, and a good understanding of the nuances of legal, regulatory, and policy frameworks that affect communities.
